metadata.title: When I get 2 kills and still wonder if Valorant glitched or I’m cheating
metadata.description:
Wait, how did THAT land? Enemy probably questioning their life choices.
My aim was gone but somehow the game said yes.
Click if your kills feel like accidental hacks!

Tap if your best plays are pure accident magic!
